concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-point-of-sale-user-manuals-terminal-deprecation-vx680-user-manual-inspect-device-security-vx680]] — 2019-modified, 2026-09-15-captured historical VX680 staff device-integrity guide: inspect weekly for damage, skimmers and tampering, verify third-party access, report suspicions, and stop use/contact Support when in doubt; old “certified” wording does not establish present certification, and the parent eVo table lists no more VX680 transactions on 29 March 2024.
warnings: Current certification and transaction support must not be inferred from the 2019 inspection guide; the later parent deprecation table supplies the dated cutoff.
